capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: ArenaEV 2022 GT Performance page lists 109.1 kWh usable; applied to 2023. Conflict: InsideEVs lists 112 usable for the Grand Touring.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: same 2170 NMC cell family; Lucid battery data lists the MY26+ packs as "Li MM(NRMC)"; no pre-2026 page names the chemistry.

preconditioning.notes: Lucid: manual Start Preconditioning plus Smart Preconditioning (automatic when routing to a fast charger). Current software state; the page is not year-specific.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: ArenaEV 2022 Grand Touring Performance page, 112 kWh total, applied to the 2023 car (no change found). Wikipedia lists 118 kWh for this trim, uncited: conflict.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: ArenaEV 2022 GT Performance DC 300 kW; InsideEVs Grand Touring up to around 300 kW.

ac_max_kw.notes: Lucid Canada charging page: AC charging maximum 19.2 kW; Wikipedia lists 19.2 kW (240 V, 80 A) for every trim.
